label: November 23–29, 2026
intro: Loy Krathong under the full moon, glowing old-town light art and a dad-and-son family run — a big, bright week!

activities.title: Loy Krathong at Benjakitti or Lumpini Park
activities.why: Thor can build his own krathong from banana leaf and flowers, then float it on the lake — making something with his hands and watching it glow.
activities.tip: Make the krathong together at home in the afternoon; go early, parks get packed after 7:30pm.

activities.title: Bambini Villa Loy Krathong Festival (daytime)
activities.why: A kid-sized Loy Krathong with crafts and games — a calmer daytime option if the evening crowds are too much.
activities.tip: Confirm times on BKK Kids before going.

activities.title: EJAN FAIR x Moon Rim Lake (Loy Krathong fair)
activities.why: Fairground stalls, lights and lake-side krathong floating — a fun evening wander.

activities.title: Hope Fair Giant Christmas Market (with Santa)
activities.why: First Santa sighting of the season plus craft and toy stalls — Thor can pick out a tiny gift.
activities.tip: Weekday crowds are lighter in the morning.

activities.title: Awakening Bangkok — free light-art festival in the old town
activities.location: Hua Lamphong to Maitri Chit (MRT Hua Lamphong)
activities.why: Giant glowing installations and projection art on old shophouses and the historic station — like walking through a sci-fi lab of lights.
activities.tip: Comfy shoes and a scooter-free plan; finish with noodles in Yaowarat a few minutes away.

activities.title: Vijit Chao Phraya — riverside light & fireworks nights
activities.date: Friday November 27 (fireworks) · nightly lights through Dec 13
activities.location: 19 riverfront spots along the Chao Phraya
activities.why: Laser and light shows on the river plus fireworks — big 'wow' moments for a 5-year-old.
activities.tip: Ride the river boat between sites; bring ear defenders for the fireworks.

activities.title: Amazing Thailand Marathon — 4.5 km Family Run
activities.why: A real race with a medal and thousands of runners — Thor can run, scoot or ride on dad's shoulders past the Grand Palace.
activities.tip: Check registration status now; roads around Rattanakosin close from 12:01am Sat, so take the MRT to Sanam Chai.

activities.title: Bangkok Theatre Festival — closing weekend family shows
activities.why: Kids' theatre and puppet shows — great for sparking his imagination after all the building and making.
activities.tip: Pick a show marked for children; arrive 15 mins early for seating.

activities.title: European Christmas Market by Bangkok Accueil
activities.why: Santa, a tombola, a choir and children's activities — a cosy first Christmas outing.

activities.title: Grow Forest School Family Day
activities.why: Outdoor nature play, building with sticks and mud — hands-on and messy in the best way.

activities.title: Arcadia Academy — 'Thai Scents, Thai Styles, Little Smiles' kids' session
activities.why: A hands-on making session — Thor gets to create something to bring home.

activities.title: The World of Disney and Pixar Animation at centralwOrld
activities.why: Big character installations from Pixar films — Thor can spot the robots and heroes (Incredibles!) and then hit The Rink upstairs.
activities.tip: Combine with ice skating at The Rink in the same mall.

activities.title: Bangkok Art Biennale 2026 at Museum Siam, Wat Pho & BACC
activities.location: Museum Siam, Wat Pho, Wat Arun, BACC and more
activities.why: Huge, weird artworks in temples and museums — perfect 'what is THAT?' moments that kick off building ideas at home.
activities.tip: Museum Siam pairs the Biennale with its hands-on galleries — easiest one for a 5-year-old.

activities.title: Koh Kerd miniature craft world at ICONSIAM
activities.why: Tiny handmade Thai worlds to peer into — great inspiration for a little builder.
activities.tip: Visit at dusk and stay for the Bangkok Illumination light shows.

activities.title: The Rink at CentralWorld — kids' beginner lessons
activities.why: His ice-skating obsession, on a smaller rink that suits little skaters better than the Olympic-size ones.
activities.tip: Weekday afternoons are quieter. Ask about a kids' starter lesson and bring gloves and long socks.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — rollerblading with 15-min basic training
activities.price: Approx. 50 THB/hr or 100 THB/day incl. skate rental (older listing)
activities.why: Rollerblades plus friendly instructors. Exactly the wheels-and-speed fix he's after.
activities.tip: Bring his own helmet and pads if you have them. Instructors teach kids, some with limited English.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand — Stark Mobile Lab & Iron Man 4D
activities.why: The one place in Bangkok with a Tony Stark lab and an Iron Man 4D cinema. Peak Thor.
activities.tip: It opened in 2018. Phone ahead or check Klook to confirm it's open before you drive out to Bangna.

activities.title: Science Center for Education (Ekkamai) — dinosaur, marine & hands-on halls
activities.date: Tue–Sun (planetarium dome still closed for renovation)
activities.location: Sukhumvit Rd, next to Ekkamai BTS
activities.why: Dinos, bugs and push-the-button science exhibits, cheap and right on the BTS. The new planetarium dome is due back late 2026 or early 2027.
activities.tip: Check the Bangkok Planetarium Facebook page; if the dome reopens, he'll want to be first in.

activities.title: National Science Museum (Khlong Luang / Rangsit) + new FUTURIUM hub
activities.why: Thailand's biggest hands-on science museum. Robots, machines and building exhibits for a future engineer.
activities.tip: It's about an hour's drive, so make it a full day. FUTURIUM is NSM's new innovation hub, so check its kid suitability.

activities.title: Museum Siam — interactive discovery museum
activities.why: Touch-and-play exhibits and dress-up corners, right by the MRT. Easy half-day.
activities.tip: Pair it with lunch near Tha Tien pier.

activities.title: Poteri Clay Workshop — kids' pottery
activities.why: He loved pottery class. Poteri runs a kids-focused course to get his hands in the clay again.
activities.tip: Book ahead. Firing takes a week or two, so plan a pick-up trip.

activities.title: Chef Lucas Baking Studio — chocolate-making class
activities.why: Chocolate making was a hit. This is a hands-on class where he makes and eats his own creations.
activities.tip: Ask about kids' or parent-and-child sessions and the minimum age.

activities.title: Rockademy — rock music school (ask about kids' drum trial)
activities.why: Drums! A real rock school where he can bash a proper kit.
activities.tip: Ask whether they take 5-year-olds for a trial lesson. If not, ask them for a kids' drum teacher.
